{{Top|leg}}
'''Hubba rind tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] made from the rinds of a [[Hubba gourd/Legends|hubba gourd]].<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]'' to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> [[Silya Darklighter]] served [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] hubba rind tea and [[Tatooine flatbread]] while she was staying at their [[Darklighter estate|farm]].<ref name="TG" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''
